source_facts: Solactive makes the greatest possible efforts to accurately calculate and maintain its indices.
Errors in the determination process may occur from time to time for variety reasons.
Errors in the determination process cannot be completely ruled out.
Solactive endeavors to correct all identified errors within a reasonable period of time.
The reasonable-period understanding and general measures depend on the underlying.
The reasonable-period understanding and general measures are specified in the Solactive Correction Policy.
The Solactive Correction Policy is incorporated by reference.
The Solactive Correction Policy is available on the Solactive website.
render_facts: Solactive uses its greatest possible efforts to calculate and maintain each index accurately.
Errors in the determination process may occur from time to time for a variety of reasons.
Errors in the determination process cannot be completely ruled out.
If an error in the determination process is identified, Solactive will endeavor to correct it within a reasonable period of time.
The understanding of what constitutes a reasonable period of time and the general measures to be taken depend on the underlying of the index.
These matters are specified in the Solactive Correction Policy.
The Solactive Correction Policy is incorporated by reference into this Guideline.
The Solactive Correction Policy is available on Solactive’s website.
